description: Put an emoji on a chat message, or take yours off, as yourself — as pressing it under the message on the screen does: one emoji ('👍', '🎉', any single emoji), on (the default) or off ('remove' true), said outright so a repeat changes nothing. The chat's open screens show it at once; nobody is notified, and no unread count moves. Anybody who may write in the chat may react; not on a deleted message, and not in a secret chat, which has no reactions. At most 10 of yours on one message. Answers with the message's reactions after it.
name: react_to_chat_message
title: React to chat message
